failure_reason: Exact product counts could not be verified: Flipkart's facetResponse.count for every listing URL fluctuates across repeated fetches of the identical URL (confirmed via a 3x re-fetch test), so qty is null with MANUAL REVIEW on every leaf row per Rule 2 (accuracy over guessing). Category structure, URLs, and existence/non-zero status are otherwise fully verified.
notes: Flipkart runs a dedicated Pet Supplies store (https://www.flipkart.com/pet-supplies/pr?sid=p3t), enumerated via the sitemap (sitemap_s_store-browse.xml.gz, filtered to /pet-supplies/ and excluding /hi/ locale duplicates, 287 URLs). Access route matched the prior Home-Decor pass note: curl_cffi Chrome impersonation with a warmed Session (GET https://www.flipkart.com/ first for cookies, then GET the target listing URL with Referer set) reliably returns full SSR HTML with a window.__INITIAL_STATE__ JSON blob; robots.txt carries no Claude-specific disallow. The top-level store front page itself (/pet-supplies/pr?sid=p3t or sid=go5, a redirect alias) renders with FILTERS widget hasWidgetFailed=true (client-side only, no SSR data) across 3 repeated fetches, but every individual leaf/category listing page rendered FILTERS successfully with a facetResponse.count. STRUCTURE: as with the prior Home-Decor pass on this same site, Flipkart exposes TWO overlapping/duplicate Pet Supplies trees: a primary species-organized tree (sid=p3t: Birds, Cats, Dogs, Fish & Aquatic, Grooming & Hygiene, Health & Safety, Horse, Large Animals, Small Animals -- 153 leaf categories, comprehensive and internally consistent) and a secondary product-type-organized tree (sid=n2a: cleaning-accessories, grooming, habitat, ornamental-accessories, pet-apparel, pet-food-health-supplies, pet-gear, storage-feeding-utensils, toys) whose leaves are almost entirely re-slices of the same p3t catalog (dog-collars vs collars-harnesses, cat-toys vs active/comfort/distraction-toys, etc.). Sampling n2a leaf counts (jump-cups, runaways, snake-sticks, collars-harnesses, pet-pads) returned the IDENTICAL implausible count 40763 across five structurally different categories -- a broken/fallback facet response, not real per-category data (the exact pattern the prior pass documented for this site's secondary 1m7 tree). The n2a tree was therefore excluded entirely as unreliable/duplicate; only the p3t tree is used below. QTY: confirmed via direct re-fetch (3x on https://www.flipkart.com/pet-supplies/dogs/dog-beds/pr?sid=p3t,ea3,as7) that facetResponse.count for an IDENTICAL URL fluctuates between fetches (9475, 9474, 9422) -- the same instability the prior Home-Decor pass documented for this site. Per Rule 2 this cannot be certified exact, so every row carries qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag; the last-observed count is quoted in evidence for reference only, not as a verified figure. EXCLUSIONS: pet-inhaler-mask dropped (facetResponse.count=0, confirmed zero-product). All 153 p3t leaves were individually fetched and none of the rest returned zero. Pet-owner-only items (e.g. human horse-riding helmets) were not present in the p3t tree so no exclusion judgement was needed there. FLAGGED PER POLICY GAPS (not decided, just recorded per brief Section 3): food/treats/chews/ health-supplements across all species flagged PET CONSUMABLE (bird/cat/dog/fish/turtle/small-animal/large-animal/horse food, treats, chews, health supplements); pet-bandage, pet-dewormer, pet-first-aid-kit, pet-oral-medication flagged PET MEDICAL / VETERINARY CATEGORY. Nothing pet-themed-only or pet-owner-apparel was found in this tree; grooming/hygiene/toys/beds/carriers/ collars/leashes/crates/houses/litter/waste categories are genuine Tier-1 Pet Care matches per the site's own species-organized taxonomy.
